telemetry_disabled_behavior_before: No explicit degradation_mode field. Telemetry settings used combinatorial booleans (mode + local_operational_enabled + share_level) but had no inspectable signal that telemetry was degraded. No test proved 3+ visible behavior differences when telemetry disabled.
telemetry_disabled_behavior_after: degradation_mode (full|degraded|disabled) added to telemetry settings schema. compute_degradation_mode() computes tiered degradation from booleans. get_telemetry_degradation_state() returns inspectable dict. 6 contract/real-artifact tests verify all 3 modes.
degraded_capabilities_proven: telemetry settings now expresses degraded_capabilities list
degradation_mode='full': local + remote both enabled, zero degraded capabilities
degradation_mode='degraded': local enabled, remote disabled → capabilities: remote_upload, shared_benchmarks, cross_user_reports, maintainer_debugging
degradation_mode='disabled': local disabled → capabilities: governed_mode, delegate_fleet, coordination_leases, queue_planning, replay_debug + all remote

debug_quarantine_behavior.before: Debug packets written to same observability.jsonl as production events. Zero quarantine. Bundle manifest had no quarantine reporting.
debug_quarantine_behavior.after: Debug packets routed to debug_quarantine.jsonl via is_debug_packet() check in log_local_event. Atomic write (temp + rename). Production observability.jsonl isolated. Bundle manifest extended with debug_packet_count, quarantined_debug_packet_count, quarantine_file_path, quarantine_note. is_debug_packet() detects prefixes: 'debug.' and 'rig.relay.debug.'.
